notes:
{女|おんな}の{子|こ} refers to a female child or young woman. The age range is flexible, from toddlers to young adults in casual usage.

RELATED TERMS:
- {女|おんな}の{子|こ}: girl (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{男|おとこ}の{子|こ}→男の子：02862_otokonoko⟧: boy
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧: child/children
- ⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧: girl (literary, often for teenagers)
- ⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧: girl/female (in compounds, schools, sports)

USAGE:
{女|おんな}の{子|こ} is the standard everyday word. It can refer to young women casually, while ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧ is more appropriate in formal contexts. In compounds like ⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ (women's restroom), ⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧ is used instead.

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading is おんなのこ, not *おんなのご.
